_comment: The fd/OFD layer's positioned-I/O contract. Its own spec because a spec mutates ONE file and these guards live in syscalls.rs, not in a filesystem -- which is the whole reason the assertions moved here from the TypeScript filesystem's tests. sys_pread and sys_pwrite are correct by construction, so every trial here ADDS an offset movement rather than removing a guard: there is no check to break, only a behaviour to violate.

trials.name: pread advances the shared offset, moving a file pointer its caller never asked to move
trials.replace:
let ofd_idx = resolve_io_ofd(proc, fd)?;
    let _ = sys_lseek(proc, host, fd, offset, SEEK_SET);

trials.name: pwrite advances the shared offset, which a forked peer would see move
trials.replace:
let ofd_idx = resolve_io_ofd(proc, fd)?;
    let _ = sys_lseek(proc, host, fd, offset, SEEK_SET);
